description: Cutting, planing, shaping, joining, laminating, and assembling wooden architectural fixtures, modular cabinetry, doors, window frames, and commercial furniture.
daily_tasks: Marking cut lines on commercial MR and BWP plywood sheets
Ripping and crosscutting plywood panels with circular saws
Smoothing timber surface and squaring edges with hand wood planer (randa)
Spreading synthetic resin adhesive (Fevicol) and laminating sunmica sheets
Chiseling mortise pockets and cutting matching tenon joints
Installing soft-close concealed hydraulic cabinet hinges
Fitting telescopic ball-bearing drawer slide channels
advanced_tasks: Fabricating curved architectural reception desks and fluted wall paneling
Crafting traditional solid teak mortise-and-tenon panel doors
Operating portable electric wood routers for edge profiling and grooving
Refinishing antique furniture with hand-rubbed French spirit polish (lakhdana)
materials: Steel screws, brad nails, concealed hinges
work_processes: Architectural Sizing -> Sheet Nesting -> Panel Saws -> Edge Planing -> Laminate Pressing -> Carcass Assembly -> Hardware Fitting -> Final Sanding & Edge Banding
troubleshooting_tasks: Eliminating air bubbles and delamination pockets in pressed sunmica sheets
Adjusting sagging cabinet shutters using 3-way concealed hinge adjustment screws
Easing sticking door stiles caused by monsoon moisture expansion
Rectifying binding drawer channels by shimming carcass out-of-square deviations
quality_inspection: Checking 90-degree squareness of assembled carcasses across opposite diagonals
Verifying seamless laminate edge trimming without chipping or visible glue lines
Confirming consistent 3mm reveal gaps around all cabinet doors and drawers
Ensuring perfectly flat joint surfaces without planer gouges
measurement_and_planning: Converting site architectural dimensions into detailed sheet cutting lists
Allowing 1mm saw blade kerf allowance in cutting layout
safety_practices: Inspecting circular saw lower blade retracting guard before every cut
Wearing N95 particulate respirators when cutting MDF and composite sheets
Never standing in direct kickback trajectory of high-speed power saws
Using push sticks when guiding narrow workpieces near power blades
maintenance: Honing and stropping planer irons and chisels to razor edge on oilstone
Removing dried PVA glue encrustations from sash clamp threads
Blowing wood dust from electric power tool motor ventilation vents
customer_communication: Advising clients on BWP marine vs commercial plywood durability in wet zones
Assisting in laminate texture and finish selection (matte, suede, high-gloss)
Explaining modular kitchen storage hardware options
canonical_skills: Adhesive Application and Laminate Sheet Pressing
Manual Wood Surface Planing and Smoothing
Wood Chisel Mortise and Tenon Joinery
Concealed Cabinet Hinge and Drawer Slide Installation
